trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property the game offers — eight in total — to earn this trophy. Garages unlock as the story opens new districts, so check the property listings each time a new area opens. The eighth purchase is the trigger, so save one cheap garage for last if you want a clean finish.
steps: Check property listings as new districts open
Buy each garage property you find
Purchase all 8 garages
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
PowerPyx — GTA VI Trophy Guide & Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Open the Scooter Bros app and register ten different vehicles to it. Any vehicle you drive can be registered, so work through the cars, bikes and scooters you already own or find. Ten registrations is the count, and the app tracks them for you.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app
Drive a vehicle, then register it in the app
Register 10 different vehicles
sources: PSNProfiles — GTA VI Trophy Guide
Exophase — Grand Theft Auto VI Trophies
